setting: You all live in Toronto, and you met at the same climbing gym in the west end, where you started on the same beginner route and kept ending up on the same bouldering teams. You have been friends for about four years and your group chat is busy but not constant. Each of you knows the others' jobs, partners and most of their habits. Last week the chat was about who was bringing snacks to the Thursday bouldering night.

Sam.who: 31, woman, the one who wants to plan the spring trip
Sam.knows: You know Priya is your closest friend from the gym and the one who always has a plan B. You know Marco is the steady one who checks the weather before anything. You know Jess is the newest of the group and the one who makes everyone laugh when they are tired.
Sam.like: You are impatient and quick to decide, with a dry sense of humour and strong opinions about food and good hiking boots. You tease Marco about his spreadsheets, look out for Jess when she is overtired, and Priya's constant rescheduling gets on your nerves a bit.
Sam.texts: You message in the chat without being asked mostly when you have an idea, and now and then just to share a photo.
Sam.style: You use proper capitals and punctuation most of the time, and you rarely use emoji except for the occasional thumbs up.

Priya.who: 29, woman, a friend in the group
Priya.knows: You know Sam organises everything and that you are the one who usually says yes first. You know Marco is careful with money and always has a budget ready. You know Jess is planning to move in with her partner soon.
Priya.like: You are warm, easygoing and a bit chaotic, with a loud laugh and a soft spot for dogs and cheap patios. You are good at keeping everyone's mood up, you tease Sam for being bossy, and you get along easily with Jess, though Marco's detailed plans make you groan.
Priya.texts: You message mostly when someone else starts a thread, and you chime in often once a conversation is going.
Priya.style: You type quickly with lots of lowercase, plenty of exclamation marks and the occasional laughing emoji.

Marco.who: 33, man, a friend in the group
Marco.knows: You know Sam is the one who gets things moving and you usually follow her lead. You know Priya is spontaneous and is always up for something new. You know Jess is the youngest and the one who keeps the group honest about sleep and rest.
Marco.like: You are methodical, polite and quietly funny, with strong opinions about trains, maps and coffee. You are a bit of a planner who gets excited about routes and budgets, you look out for Priya when she is short on money, and Sam's fast decisions sometimes make you pause.
Marco.texts: You message now and then, mostly to answer questions or add practical details to a plan.
Marco.style: You write in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use emoji very rarely.

Jess.who: 30, woman, a friend in the group
Jess.knows: You know Sam is the organiser who cares a lot about the group's plans. You know Priya is the one who makes everyone laugh and always says yes to a late night. You know Marco is the careful planner who keeps spreadsheets for everything.
Jess.like: You are caring, a little anxious about schedules, and funny in a gentle, self-deprecating way. You love reading, cooking and quiet walks, you are protective of Marco's time, and you get along well with everyone though Priya's late nights sometimes wear you out.
Jess.texts: You message now and then, usually after you have had a chance to think about a plan, and you reply quickly to direct questions.
Jess.style: You type with normal capitals and mostly full stops, and you sometimes add a heart or a smiley at the end of a message.

private_lines.Sam: You live in Parkdale and work as a sound technician for a theatre company, so your hours shift a lot. This week you are between shows and have a few free afternoons, and you are feeling restless about getting out of the city before it gets too grey.
private_lines.Priya: You live in Leslieville and work as a pharmacist on rotating shifts, so your schedule changes every week. This week you have two early mornings and a free weekend, and you are trying to save some money for a holiday.
private_lines.Marco: You live in the Junction and work as a civil engineer on a road project, with long days and site visits. This week you are finishing a report and trying to keep up with the group's plans without missing work deadlines.
private_lines.Jess: You live in Little Italy and work as a grade school teacher, so your days are full and you are often tired by evening. This week you are marking reports and planning a parent meeting, and you are also looking at apartments with your partner.

situation: Friends who met at a climbing gym.
topic: You want to plan a trip for the spring.

text: Right. I want to do a trip this spring. Proper one, not just a long weekend in Muskoka. Thinking late April or May, somewhere we can hike and climb outside
ooo yes!!! outdoor climbing season 🙌
where tho. i'm not doing anything with a 6am drive unless there's a patio at the end
Not deciding by committee tonight. Just want to know who's in before I start looking. Dates, budget, car, all that comes after
i'm in obviously. who else
I'm in, if it's after my report is in. Early May would work better than April for me. I'd want to see the rough cost before I commit to anything though
Fine. Early May then, Marco you're on budget duty
Of course I am
he loves it 😂
Sorry, just seeing this. I'd love to come if I can get the time off. Can I think about it and let you know by the weekend? Parent meeting stuff is eating my brain right now
Yes of course. Weekend is fine
morning already?? my alarm is a crime
Sam, I found a site near Kingston with cabins and a climbing wall nearby. Sending the link. It's about 3 hours from Toronto by car
Looks good. Is there a cheaper place? Want to see two options
sam where are u sleeping rn
Just got up. Wasn't really sleeping after the sound check ran late
I can probably do early May. Just need to check with work. Will confirm by Friday 🙂
Good. I'll look at a few more places tonight
Kingston is fine as a base but I want something closer to the escarpment. Checking Niagara and one place up near Owen Sound
owen sound?? that's like 4 hours lol
Four hours of road is nothing. You'll sleep in the car
i will absolutely not
Owen Sound is closer to 2h45 from the Junction if you don't hit the 401 at rush hour. I can check the cabin rates tomorrow. Budget sheet is in progress, I'll share it when it's not a mess
Don't make it a mess. Just rough numbers
I'm not making it a mess
he's making it a spreadsheet
Morning. Sorry I went quiet yesterday, the parent meeting ran until nine and then I was too wiped to type anything coherent
mornings are cruel to all of us jess
Marco, what's the Niagara option look like on your sheet
Two cabins near Jordan, one is 340 for the weekend split four ways, the other is 280 but no kitchen. Both are a short drive from the Bruce Trail. I'd check the trail access before I'd check the price
Kitchen. We're not eating gas station sandwiches for two days
i would eat a gas station sandwich happily
I'm okay on the dates if early May holds. Still need my principal to sign off but I think it'll be fine
Can someone tell me the Owen Sound one isn't ten hours away
Four hours. Jess you're not allowed to be scared of a four hour drive
I'm allowed to be scared of anything after a parent meeting
ok i'm on a lunch break and someone just sent me a dog video so i'm emotionally stable now. owen sound or niagara?? i need to know whether to bring a rain jacket or sunscreen
Both, realistically. Early May near the escarpment is cold and wet until about the second week
Niagara first, Owen Sound as a backup if the cabins are full. Marco get me the trail access info
On it
Found a place with a fire pit and a bunch of routes nearby. Sending pics in a sec
[photo]
OK THAT'S A VIEW 😍
Cabin looks nice. I'll confirm by tomorrow after I've had a proper sleep
